description:
boundary_tags/1 denylist-copies the whole ExUnit context into every boundary row in a suite-lifetime :public ETS table; nothing in lib/ reads it. Suite-lifetime retention of O(tests × context), extra deep-copy on the per-test hot path, denylist must track ExUnit keys forever. Drop :tags from the row, collapse tail/3→tail/2, update boundary_test.exs:76 assertion + coverage_capture.spec.md api surface. If a consumer appears later, use an allowlist (Map.take/2). Report F4/CF3.
